objective: Locate Jaron Stoneshaper's wrecked camp and supplies in southern Winterspring.

description: Hey there, lad/lass! I was chased from my camp in southern Winterspring by some bloodthirsty wildkin! Well, I suppose I got too close to something the wildkin were guarding.

I barely managed to get away safely; I fear a buddy of mine wasn't as lucky. Would you mind braving the wildkin and heading to the camp? I really need my supplies, and I'd also like to get back the amulet I unearthed yesterday at the dig site.
completion: A severely damaged crate stands out among the rest of the destroyed belongings at the camp...
